## Challenges

- API Access : I accidentally posting my username and password to my public git and took it down shortly after however the newly generate username ans password didn't work so I had to use the leaked version.
- Missing ID's : About 16% of ids belong to deleted or private patterns and most batch's of 50 at least one.
- Collection Time : Took a very long time to collect all 30,000 postings but relatively straight forward collection process

## Benchmarks

- There had been other projects done using the Ravlery API. Including another DSAN 5000 project however my goals and objects differ from any work i can find currently. First the way I am gathering random id's and having lots of variation in patterns as the other pattern top only top ranked patterns. Seconf the goals are completely different i am looking at popularity and factors that go into it and they tried to identify pattern type.

## Conclusion and Future Steps

- I collected Ravelry patterns from randomly sampled ids saved as a raw JSON
- Next steps are data cleaning and feature creation
- Also future additions to collection could be collecting user comments and collecting future patterns and data to comapre between months and how patterns change over time.
